name: datapack-sandbox-vscode
description: Edit, validate, run, test, debug, and inspect Minecraft Java datapacks with Datapack Sandbox.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run bundle-cli && npm run compile

commands.title: Datapack Sandbox: Run Current Mcfunction With Pack
Datapack Sandbox: Run Current Mcfunction in Active Sandbox
Datapack Sandbox: Debug Current File in Active Sandbox
Datapack Sandbox: Run Manifest in Active Sandbox
Datapack Sandbox: Render Active Sandbox to PNG
Datapack Sandbox: Show Active Sandbox Coverage
Datapack Sandbox: Reset Active Sandbox Coverage
Datapack Sandbox: Open Loaded Function Source
Datapack Sandbox: Generate Manifest For Current Function

datapackSandbox.javaPath.description: Java executable used to run the Datapack Sandbox CLI jar.

datapackSandbox.cliJarPath.description: Optional path to a custom datapack-sandbox-cli.jar. The extension uses its bundled CLI when this is empty.

datapackSandbox.autoBuildCliJar.description: Build :cli:fatJar automatically in a Datapack Sandbox source workspace when no bundled or configured CLI jar is available.

datapackSandbox.defaultVersion.description: Optional Minecraft version profile override. Empty uses the bundled CLI's canonical default profile.

datapackSandbox.packPaths.description: Extra datapack folder or zip paths passed to run/debug/sandbox operations.

datapackSandbox.language.enabled.description: Start an isolated JVM language session for mcfunction completion, hover, definitions, and profile-aware validation. TextMate syntax highlighting remains available when disabled.

datapackSandbox.language.diagnostics.description: Validate open mcfunction documents against the selected Datapack Sandbox profile and loaded datapacks.

datapackSandbox.language.diagnosticDelay.description: Milliseconds to debounce profile-aware mcfunction diagnostics while typing.

datapackSandbox.defaultPlayerName.description: Player created when an active sandbox starts. Empty starts without a default player.

datapackSandbox.strict.description: Use strict validation for manifest checks and quick runs.

datapackSandbox.traceFilter.description: Trace filters passed to CLI run/check operations.

datapackSandbox.reportDirectory.description: Directory for temporary run/check reports. Defaults to the OS temp directory.

enumDescriptions: Create an isolated sandbox for each run or debug session.
Use the currently active persistent sandbox.
datapackSandbox.defaultExecutionTarget.description: Default target used by Run and Debug commands. Temporary preserves the original isolated behavior.

datapackSandbox.coverage.minimumLine.description: Minimum accumulated line coverage percentage used by Show Coverage.

datapackSandbox.coverage.minimumFunction.description: Minimum accumulated function coverage percentage used by Show Coverage.

datapackSandbox.coverage.include.description: Resource-id glob patterns included in active-sandbox coverage.

datapackSandbox.coverage.exclude.description: Resource-id glob patterns excluded from active-sandbox coverage.

datapackSandbox.render.width.description: Width of PNG frames rendered by the bundled JAR.

datapackSandbox.render.height.description: Height of PNG frames rendered by the bundled JAR.

datapackSandbox.render.fieldOfView.description: Vertical field of view used by JAR rendering.

datapackSandbox.render.distance.description: Maximum modeled render distance in blocks.

datapackSandbox.render.minecraftAssetsPa.description: Minecraft client asset directory or jar used for local rendering. Configure this manually; the extension never searches Minecraft installations.

datapackSandbox.render.resourcePackPaths.description: Workspace-relative or absolute resource-pack paths manually passed to the JAR renderer.

datapackSandbox.render.playerSkins.description: Player names mapped to workspace-relative or absolute PNG skin paths.

datapackSandbox.render.cameraPlayer.description: Player camera name. Empty uses entity, fixed, or automatic camera selection.

datapackSandbox.render.cameraEntity.description: Entity UUID camera used when cameraPlayer is empty.

datapackSandbox.render.cameraPosition.description: Fixed [x, y, z] camera position used when player and entity cameras are empty.

datapackSandbox.render.cameraYaw.description: Yaw in degrees for a fixed camera.

datapackSandbox.render.cameraPitch.description: Pitch in degrees for a fixed camera.

datapackSandbox.render.cameraDimension.description: Dimension resource id for a fixed camera.

datapackSandbox.render.transparentBackgr.description: Render the world with a transparent background.

datapackSandbox.render.showHud.description: Draw the modeled HUD in rendered PNGs.

datapackSandbox.render.showDebugOverlay.description: Draw renderer diagnostics over rendered PNGs.

datapackSandbox.render.strictAssets.description: Fail rendering when configured client or resource-pack assets cannot be resolved.

version.description: Optional profile override; empty uses the bundled CLI default.

sandbox.description: Run in a new temporary sandbox or the active persistent sandbox.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause on the first trace event instead of running to the first breakpoint.
